biocs.name: Svchost loads rare unsigned module
biocs.description: Detection of svchost.exe loading an unsigned module not typically seen in normal operations
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '.dll'
| filter action_file_signature_status = 'unsigned'
| comp count() as events by actor_process_image_name, agent_hostname
| sort desc events

abiocs.name: Unusual svchost DLL load behavior
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where svchost.exe loads an unsigned DLL not commonly seen in baseline
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '.dll'
| filter action_file_signature_status = 'unsigned'
| comp count() as cnt by action_file_path
